evidence.title: Bermuda Government Department of Planning, State of the Environment
evidence.inspected_fact: The introductory geography states Bermuda lies isolated in the western Atlantic at 32°19′ N, 64°46′ W, nearest Cape Hatteras, North Carolina; it is often mistaken as Caribbean but lies over 1,200 km north of the nearest Caribbean island. This directly contradicts botanical convenience grouping.

evidence.title: Government of the Netherlands, Caribbean parts of the Kingdom
evidence.inspected_fact: The page explicitly dates Curaçao and St Maarten becoming autonomous countries, and Bonaire/St Eustatius/Saba becoming special municipalities, to10 October 2010. A 2026 geographic label Netherlands Antilles should not imply the dissolved political entity.

evidence.title: Administrative taxonomy of Cuba (secondary)
evidence.inspected_fact: Text identifies municipality reference established bylaw1304/1976 and 2010 provincial reform creating Artemisa/Mayabeque; source 2017 units still require full coast/vintage review.

evidence.title: Administrative taxonomy of Dominican Republic (secondary)
evidence.inspected_fact: Distinguishes municipalities, municipal districts and special Distrito Nacional; administrative names do not by themselves certify city envelopes or 2026coverage.

evidence.title: French official geographic API, Martinique communes
evidence.inspected_fact: Actual JSON enumerates34 communes, including Fort-de-France, Le Lamentin and Le Marin; atlas currently has one Martinique location.

evidence.title: French official geographic API, Guadeloupe communes
evidence.inspected_fact: Actual JSON enumerates32 communes; atlas currently has one Guadeloupe location with six land components. New commune-plus-island coverage needs dated licensed boundaries, not arbitrary subdivisions.

evidence.title: Administrative taxonomy of Haiti (secondary)
evidence.inspected_fact: Lists named arrondissements and department relationships; these are coarser than communes and need district/local-purpose review.

evidence.title: Administrative taxonomy of Honduras (secondary)

evidence.title: Administrative taxonomy of Jamaica (secondary)

evidence.title: Administrative taxonomy of Nicaragua (secondary)

evidence.title: US Census Bureau geographic levels

It also documents economic-census-specific combinations; no automatic city aggregation follows from ADM number.

Belize: Named remote-island/local source reference inspected in actual metadata; full subordinate-island membership, coastline retention, local settlement purpose and dated official-source crosswalk remain unverified. A whole territory is not automatically a coherent city. Costa Rica: Named local references and source vintages were inspected, with independent secondary taxonomy corroboration; actual current groups and every member ID are inventoried, but primary dated boundaries/local-purpose checks remain open. El Salvador: The2007 source calls271 retained geometries municipalities (source 272). Secondary updated Spanish listing describes2023law762 replacing262 municipalities with 44 municipalities and former municipalities as districts. This cardinality/vintage/role discrepancy requires legal and full-source crosswalk; failed primarylaw download is not counted as confirmation. France: Martinique and Guadeloupe are whole-department locations while ordinary local municipalities exist; this is a concrete granularity mismatch. Clipperton is a named remote atoll exception, independent from French political affiliation. Guatemala: Named local references and source vintages were inspected, with independent secondary taxonomy corroboration; actual current groups and every member ID are inventoried, but primary dated boundaries/local-purpose checks remain open. Honduras: Named local references and source vintages were inspected, with independent secondary taxonomy corroboration; actual current groups and every member ID are inventoried, but primary dated boundaries/local-purpose checks remain open. Mexico: Inspected all 2,441 original municipality geometries against pinned source states; source administrative affiliation is supported, not blanket local geometry approval.2012 vintage,31<95% state-coverage cases, one Distrito Federal city aggregation, Oaxaca’s570 local members and regional botanical envelopes remain explicit issues. Nicaragua: Named local references and source vintages were inspected, with independent secondary taxonomy corroboration; actual current groups and every member ID are inventoried, but primary dated boundaries/local-purpose checks remain open. Panama: Named local references and source vintages were inspected, with independent secondary taxonomy corroboration; actual current groups and every member ID are inventoried, but primary dated boundaries/local-purpose checks remain open.

checks.footprint_method: Union of member location footprints; no independent parent polygon

assessment.rationale: Inspected actual 464 location members and 6 child groups. Current role: Atlas macro-group of published North American regional memberships; US/Canadian groups may share a parent, independently of political ownership. Canada: Municipality/census-division/physical-ecoregion roles are mixed. All 478 actual names were checked: no live numbered/unorganized administrative-remainder label remains. Retained municipalities, larger division aggregates and 269 ecological adaptations need independently significant settlement and source-clipping checks; sparse land is not automatically a settlement. Saint Pierre and Miquelon: Named remote-island/local source reference inspected in actual metadata; full subordinate-island membership, coastline retention, local settlement purpose and dated official-source crosswalk remain unverified. A whole territory is not automatically a coherent city. United States of America: County-equivalent local reference is defensible, but2018 vintage differs from modern Connecticut; county-based city aggregation and Alaska’s ecologically clipped census areas still need functional/local review.

evidence.title: Statistics Canada SGC 2021
evidence.inspected_fact: Defines geographic regions, provinces/territories, census divisions (including counties/regional county municipalities), and census subdivisions (municipalities); SGC variants group census subdivisions. These roles are distinct, not equivalent ADM integers.

evidence.title: AAFC National Ecological Framework for Canada
evidence.inspected_fact: Government page states the framework was developed in 1991–1999; 1995 report defines ecozones, ecoregions, ecodistricts and 1999 report adds ecoprovinces. They are physical/ecological references, not municipal or historical divisions.

evidence.title: Brummitt, WGSRPD second edition (2001)
evidence.inspected_fact: Inspected its continent introduction and level 3/4 table. It places Bermuda in the Caribbean "for convenience"; Netherlands Antilles lists Bonaire and Curaçao; LEE is named Leeward Is. and lists individual northern island groups. This botanical recording convention is not physical geography certification.

evidence.title: US Census Bureau geographic levels
evidence.inspected_fact: The official page distinguishes counties and county equivalents, including Alaska boroughs/census areas, independent cities, Louisiana parishes and District of Columbia. It also documents economic-census-specific combinations; no automatic city aggregation follows from ADM number.

evidence.title: US Census Bureau county-equivalent changes in2020s
evidence.inspected_fact: Official page records finalized adoption of Connecticut’s nine Councils of Governments as county-equivalent geographic units and links the planning-region crosswalk/map. The atlas retains eight2018 counties, so that geometry must be explicitly vintage reference, not current administration.

remaining_reasons: Lower-tier source footprints, dates and functional/local purposes require review; this record does not approve all member locations.
